problems: Prussia's land depends on the hierarchy rows, not on the size rule: the orchestrator must add kingdom-of-prussia -> north-german-confederation (1867-1870, constituent) and kingdom-of-prussia -> german-empire (1871-1918, constituent) in the same compile as this batch. Prussia has no Cliopatria area after 1863 (shapes.csv kingdom-of-prussia rows end 1863), so its size is its cell count, about 1,450-1,525 cells (the NGC held 1,525 cells at p1870, taken from Prussia) = c. 370,000-385,000 km2; the NGC's found region (German Confederation 1863 + Hanover, Hesse-Kassel, Nassau, Frankfurt, Schleswig-Holstein, Hohenzollern, c. 356,000 km2) in 1867 and its Cliopatria area of 365,059 km2 in its 1868 keyframe year are likely smaller, so the size rule would hand the NGC Prussia's cells in 1867/1868, and the NGC's December 1870 dissolve would pass them to the German Empire (Prussia has no keyframe from-year after 1866 to claim them back). The notes in north-german-confederation ledger/0 and the fix-fx-53 notes ('Prussia wins: size rule now') overstate this; against the German Empire (660,482 / 557,015 km2) Prussia does win by size.
